title: Irish Soda Bread
description: A traditional Irish bread made with buttermilk, often served with butter or jam.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, combine oatmeal, crumbly bread, soda, and salt.
3. Add butter and mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Make a well in the center of the mixture and pour in buttermilk.
5. Mix the dough until it comes together in a sticky ball.
6. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead for 5-10 minutes.
7. Shape the dough into a round loaf and place it on a baking sheet.
8. Cut a cross in the top of the loaf and bake for 35-40 minutes.
9. Remove from oven and let cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes.
